# Motor Examination

## Bulk

-   Atrophy
-   Fasciculations

## Tone

-   **Flaccid**
-   **Spastic / Clasp-knife -** resistance changes with velocity/force applied
-   **Rigid / Lead-pipe -** resistance remains similar despite change in velocity/force applied
-   **Paratonia** --- distraction/calming can "break" the increase in tone

## Strength Testing (MRC Scale)

**0** = No movement\
**1** = Trace movement, muscle activation\
**2** = Limb movement in plane of bed (gravity eliminated)\
**3** = Movement against gravity\
**4** = Spectrum of resistance to force (4-- = 25%, 4 = 50%, 4+ = 75%)\
**5** = Full strength

**Additional observations**: Drift, satelliting/orbiting

::: callout-tip
Always test **against gravity first**, then add resistance. Look for **pronator drift** (upper) and **leg drift** (lower)
:::

**Functional Tests**\
- Heel walking (L4/L5 -- foot dorsiflexion)\
- Toe walking (S1/S2 -- plantar flexion)\
- Rise from chair with arms crossed\
- Squat / deep knee bend

# Upper Extremity Strength Testing

| Action                                  | Muscles                                    | Nerve                           | Root Levels    |
|-----------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------|---------------------------------|----------------|
| Arm abduction at shoulder               | Deltoid                                    | Axillary                        | **C5, C6**     |
| Elbow flexion (forearm supinated)       | Biceps, Brachialis                         | Musculocutaneous                | **C5, C6**     |
| Elbow extension                         | Triceps                                    | Radial                          | **C6, C7, C8** |
| Wrist extension & hand abduction        | Extensor carpi radialis                    | Radial                          | **C5, C6**     |
| Wrist flexion & hand abduction          | Flexor carpi radialis                      | Median                          | **C6, C7**     |
| Wrist flexion & hand adduction          | Flexor carpi ulnaris                       | Ulnar                           | **C7, C8, T1** |
| Finger extension                        | Extensor digitorum, indicis, digiti minimi | Radial (posterior interosseous) | **C7, C8**     |
| Thumb abduction (perpendicular to palm) | Abductor pollicis brevis                   | Median                          | **C8, T1**     |
| Thumb abduction (in plane of palm)      | Abductor pollicis longus                   | Radial (posterior interosseous) | **C7, C8**     |
| Thumb opposition                        | Opponens pollicis                          | Median                          | **C8, T1**     |
| Finger abduction                        | Dorsal interossei, Abductor digiti minimi  | Ulnar                           | **C8, T1**     |
| Finger & thumb adduction                | Adductor pollicis, Palmar interossei       | Ulnar                           | **C8, T1**     |
| DIP flexion digits 2--3                 | Flexor digitorum profundus (2,3)           | Median                          | **C7, C8**     |
| DIP flexion digits 4--5                 | Flexor digitorum profundus (4,5)           | Ulnar                           | **C7, C8**     |

# Lower Extremity Strength Testing

| Action               | Muscles                                                      | Nerve                | Root Levels    |
|----------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------|----------------|
| Hip flexion          | Iliopsoas                                                    | Femoral              | **L1--L4**     |
| Knee extension       | Quadriceps                                                   | Femoral              | **L2, L3, L4** |
| Knee flexion         | Hamstrings (semitendinosus, semimembranosus, biceps femoris) | Sciatic              | **L5, S1, S2** |
| Hip abduction        | Gluteus medius/minimus, Tensor fasciae latae                 | Superior gluteal     | **L4, L5, S1** |
| Hip adduction        | Adductors (longus, magnus, brevis), Gracilis                 | Obturator            | **L2, L3, L4** |
| Foot dorsiflexion    | Tibialis anterior                                            | Deep peroneal        | **L4, L5**     |
| Toe dorsiflexion     | Extensor hallucis longus, Extensor digitorum longus          | Deep peroneal        | **L5, S1**     |
| Foot plantar flexion | Gastrocnemius, Soleus (Triceps surae)                        | Tibial               | **S1, S2**     |
| Foot eversion        | Peroneus longus & brevis                                     | Superficial peroneal | **L5, S1**     |
| Foot inversion       | Tibialis posterior                                           | Tibial               | **L4, L5**     |
